data.description: Sometimes work items get left stuck in in_progress. Every 30 seconds the herdr plugin should retrieve all in_progress work items and attempt to match an active pane to the work item. If none is found then set to either completed, blocked or open. This work item should be blocked on the one to add work item id to pane titles, which can then be used to match panes. All tabs in the current workspace should be searched.
data.title: Herdr hydrator: rescue in_progress work items with no active pane
